comments.content: Missing newline at end of file. Add a trailing newline to comply with POSIX standards and avoid git warnings.

API_TOKEN and PROJECT_ID are read from env but not validated. If either is missing/empty, the script will send undefined to POEditor and fail with a confusing error. Add early validation with a clear error message.

The array-to-object conversion assumes each item has `term` and `definition` properties. POEditor's JSON export format may differ (e.g., `key`/`value` or nested contexts). Add a fallback or log the structure when conversion fails to aid debugging.
The default language in the workflow is 'tr,gb' but the script defaults to 'tr,en'. Align them (likely 'en' not 'gb' for English).

The workflow creates a package.json in .github/scripts on every run. This is fragile and slow. Instead, commit a package.json and package-lock.json in .github/scripts/ and use `npm ci` for reproducible, faster installs.

The commit step uses `git push` without a remote/branch. In GitHub Actions, this works only if the checkout includes full history and the token has push rights. Safer to use `git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }}` or the `git push` with explicit refspec. Also consider using `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0` if history is needed.

The commit step will fail silently if there are no changes (git diff --staged --quiet exits 0, so no commit, but git push still runs and may error). Wrap push in the same conditional or use `git push` only after a commit was made.
